      "observations": [
        "All 12 owned paths and changed test hunks were read after the path/conditional scope check. The patch replaces nsIEwsServer.idl with IExchangeOutgoingServer.idl, updates XPIDL_SOURCES, all five changed browser-test/helper QueryInterface sites, the EWS unit-test setup, the Rust XPCOM implementation declaration and the taskgraph test fixture's changed-path entry.",
        "The original and replacement interfaces retain UUID 09f44948-e01d-40a7-af19-13dbb6ae1fb5 and a void initialize(AUTF8String) method. The parameter changes from ewsURL to apiBaseURL and the comment names an Exchange-based outgoing server. The Rust initializer body is unchanged: parse the endpoint, set its OnceCell or return NS_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED, then store PrefName::EwsUrl. This is a checked source-level contract, not a compiled ABI guarantee.",
        "Both actual EWS and Graph constructors instantiate protocol_shared::outgoing::OutgoingServer with protocol-specific client constructors. The production account-creation branch accepts ews or graph and queries the renamed interface. Existing protocol names, EwsUrl/ews_url storage names and nsEwsOutgoingServerConstructor names remain; this patch does not rename the whole protocol.",
        "The historical EWS send tests await the outgoing listener before checking the Basic Authorization scheme and credentials, and wait for the distinguished sentitems folder to receive one message. Browser-test consumers check EWS settings/editability, certificate dialog details and eventual sent-message content. Only setup interface names change; no assertion or new test scenario is added.",
        "Manual review found consistent IExchangeOutgoingServer spelling across generated declarations and JS/Rust consumers. The IDL comment broadens the actor and gives the API URL parameter a concrete role. Existing inspected certificate helpers have missing assertion messages: compose certificate telemetry checks at 271–277 and account checkButtons at 664–679. These are pre-existing caller-scope diagnostic limits, not regressions introduced by the rename. The present non-empty-message instruction still applies to future edits.",
        "At the fixed accepted revision the interface still has the same name and UUID but exposes exchangeUrl instead of initialize. configureOutgoingServer and all five checked setup consumers use the property; Rust SetExchangeUrl still rejects a second assignment. This later API phase is separate from the owned rename. Existing endpoint/property guidance is linked rather than repeated.",
        "The cr-onpush.yml hunk only replaces the old IDL path in a test parameter fixture. It does not by itself prove live scheduling or a successful taskgraph run.",

        "The complete D289804 timeline has no actual inline bodies or summary/test-plan edit histories. The reviewer accepts the outgoing-specific name, then asks to reparent the release-spanning work; the author updates the Bug field and title to 2027139 before landing. This is historical workflow context, not a new global rule.",
        "The author reports a Try run with sticky xpcshell failures that appeared pre-existing, using qualified language. Linked runs were not opened, so neither pre-existence nor a successful test result is independently established.",
        "The source-stage pending-discussion fields are historical preparation state. This joined audit resolves the exact primary and own-review scope; dependency and no-runtime limits remain."
